mapper.insert: INSERT INTO party (dungeon_id, leader_id, title, description, status, max_members, created_at) VALUES (#{dungeonId}, #{leaderId}, #{title}, #{description}, #{status}, #{maxMember}, #{createdAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE party SET dungeon_id = #{dungeonId}, leader_id = #{leaderId}, title = #{title}, description = #{description}, status = #{status}, max_members = #{maxMember} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select:
SELECT p.id AS party_id, p.title, p.description, p.status, p.max_members, p.created_at, IFNULL(pm_all.count, 0) AS current_members, prr.job_class_code, prr.max_count, IFNULL(pm_by_role.count, 0) AS current_count FROM party p
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT party_id, COUNT(*) AS count FROM party_member GROUP BY party_id ) pm_all ON p.id = pm_all.party_id
LEFT JOIN party_role_requirement prr ON p.id = prr.party_id
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT party_id, job_code, COUNT(*) AS count FROM party_member GROUP BY party_id, job_code ) pm_by_role ON p.id = pm_by_role.party_id AND prr.job_class_code = pm_by_role.job_code
WHERE p.dungeon_id = #{dungeonId} AND p.status = 'MATCHING'
